Maya (CS): Quick heads-up 0 Opal Finance needs a short APAC QPS bump for an investor demo next Thursday. They expect a spike to ~300 QPS for ~3 hours; renewal rep says this demo is critical.
Ethan (SE): Which region/endpoints/models and source IPs? Also need the org ID for the rule.
Maya (CS): Customer-provided details: region=ap-southeast-1 (SG). Endpoints: /v1/generate (model gpt-redwood-8k) and /v1/embeddings. Current org QPS=60, requested peak QPS=300. Requested window: 2024-12-05T10:00:00+08:00 to 2024-12-05T13:00:00+08:00. CIDRs: 52.74.128.0/22, 13.250.0.0/16. Org: opal-finance-prod. They'll upload a signed addendum to support ticket.
Liam (NetOps): We can add those CIDRs to the APAC edge allowlist and deploy a timebound policy. We'll require the signed addendum in the ticket before applying. Plan to set an automatic revoke after the window and a safety fallback throttle. ETA ~30m once ticket verified.
Ava (Support): Opening ticket now for audit trail and attachment. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/88121 0 please add the signed doc there. I'll add rollback steps.
Ethan (SE): Recommend a model override to limit resource strain: set /v1/generate -> gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch and enable prefix KV caching for their sessions. Proposed JSON to ops: 
```{"org":"opal-finance-prod","region":"ap-southeast-1","requested_qps":"300","window":"2024-12-05T10:00:00+08:00/2024-12-05T13:00:00+08:00","allowlist":["52.74.128.0/22","13.250.0.0/16"],"model_overrides":{"/v1/generate":"gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch"},"auto_revoke":"true"}```
Liam (NetOps): OK. We'll implement with auto_revoke and set a fallback throttle at 120 QPS if backend pressure exceeds thresholds. Will run a canary and post results.
ops-bot: Change request queued: #CR-9407 0 temp-apac-qps-opal-finance-prod assigned to @Liam.
Liam (NetOps): Change applied: edge allowlist updated, route policy set, temp QPS=300 live, fallback=120 QPS, auto-revoke scheduled for 2024-12-05T13:05:00+08:00. Canary: 200 OK, latency nominal.
Ava (Support): Uploaded signed addendum and rollback checklist to ticket 88121. Note: "Temp QPS exception granted pending demo; auto-revoke scheduled; billing notified."
Maya (CS): I'll notify renewal/opps and attach the ticket and addendum. Customer plans a rehearsal tomorrow and will report issues.
Ethan (SE): I'll monitor latency/error rates and keep an eval probe running to detect any quality drift from reduced-batch. Will post alerts if errors >2% or p95 latency increases >150ms.
Liam (NetOps): Quick cost estimate for billing: ~USD 500 incremental for the 3h burst (GPU + edge). I'll confirm exact after metrics close out.
ops-bot: Change request #CR-9407 status=applied auto-revoke=scheduled.
Maya (CS): Follow-up: rehearsal went fine, demo succeeded, customer reported better confidence in renewal. Please append final cost to ticket for renewal ops. Thanks everyone :tada:
